manufacturer.name: Teckentrup
manufacturer.note: German door manufacturer with a download centre carrying brochures, data sheets, approvals and installation instructions. No model-level PDF URL was surfaced, so none is claimed. Its UK arm publishes installation instructions as static PDFs under teckentrup.co.uk/assets/content/images - an images path serving documents, which is why a harvester filtering on directory name would miss them. Registered as a target. Covers carry dates in a MM I YYYY form (06I2019).

documents.title: Industrial Sectional Doors Installation, Operating and Maintenance Instructions
documents.evidence: On teckentrup.co.uk, the manufacturer's UK domain. The sectional model codes listed as aliases come from the UK downloads page, which names SW 40, SW 80, SLW 40, SLW 80, SL 40, SL 80 and SLX 40 as having installation instructions - they are aliases so a search lands, not a claim that this one document covers all seven. Not fetched - egress blocked.
